title: API
subtitle: Manage API Integration Keys and Webhook Subscriptions to automate your workflows.
apiKeysDesc: API Keys are used to authenticate access to our order creation services.
noKeysDesc: Generate an API Key to start integrating with your application.
revokeKeyConfirm: Are you sure you want to revoke (deactivate) this API Key? This action cannot be undone.
toastCreateKeySuccess: Successfully generated API Key. Please copy the key below.
webhooksDesc: Receive automated HTTP POST notifications when orders change state or milestone statuses.
noWebhooksDesc: Link a payload URL to automatically receive tracking milestone updates.
toastSelectEvent: Please select at least one event to subscribe
deleteWebhookConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this webhook?
rotateSecretConfirm: Are you sure you want to rotate this webhook's secret key? Clients will need to update their signature verification on their servers.
toastPingSuccess: Sent ping event to test connection. Please reload the logs tab to see results.
sigVerifyDesc: Verify the signature in the X-Webhook-Signature header to ensure payload integrity and authenticity.
sigVerifyHeaders: Each sent payload contains the following headers:
sigVerifyTimestamp: X-Webhook-Timestamp: The timestamp of the webhook event.
sigVerifySignature: X-Webhook-Signature: The HMAC SHA-256 signature computed from: timestamp + '.' + body
modalCreateKeyDesc: Create a new secret key to authenticate your integration requests.
modalCreateKeyWarning: IMPORTANT: Copy this key now. For security reasons, it will never be shown again!
modalAddWebhookDesc: Configure an HTTP endpoint to receive event payloads.
modalCreateKeyAllowedIpsDesc: Enter a list of IPv4/IPv6 addresses separated by commas to restrict requests to trusted servers.
